# `request-media-type-removed`

Request media type removed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `error` |
| **Rule IDs** | `request-media-type-removed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Request bodies ([RULES.md section 5](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

A request body no longer accepts a media type. Media types compare case-insensitively.

## Why this default

Clients sending that media type get 415 responses.

## Example

From test case [`request-media-type-removed`](../../test/cases/request-media-type-removed/): A request media type clients may send was removed.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
              schema:
                type: object
-           application/xml:
-             schema:
-               type: object
        responses:
          '200':
```

Findings:

- `request-media-type-removed` · error · POST /pets

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  request-media-type-removed: error
```

## How to fix

Keep accepting the media type until clients have moved.
